cast: THE FOUNDER HEAVEN ALLEGORY, a thesis on why hard work alone does not beat the dark: a jungle of opportunity under a floating protopian island, camouflaged space elevators that carry everyone who reaches them until each goes dark forever on a day nobody knows (a takeoff window the jungle never posts), myths written by the people still on the ground, stories from above arriving smudged, a prophet with a million followers whose broadcast lands after the dark or too close to it, and the island's keepers (never depicted, never named) dropping small orange compasses that point toward the live elevator. NEW: the-camouflaged-elevator (visual-metaphor, code-drawn elevation, master/camouflaged/ascending/defunct), founder-heaven (setting, establishing + terrace, silhouette elevation), the-jungle (setting, establishing + scale section), the-prophet (archetype character, never a named real person), the-orange-compass (prop, added in the 2026-08-08 mechanics revision). REUSE: maya (the seeker who works harder than everyone; crossover: she is the visitor who walked through the door at the end of nobody-labeled-the-door), chrissy (the finder who tells her friends first; her locked voice IS the title), engineer (the plain-spoken circle member). Aim discipline: one island only, never two in a sky; the island never appears before its spread-02 reveal; smudged pages never carry readable letters; the prophet is warm and late, never a villain; the compass is unbranded (no lettering, no logo, clay-orange never neon) and the keepers stay off-page; capacity is NEVER scarce (revised 2026-08-08; earlier three-seats framing superseded, not contradicted: the ride was always warm and open, the scarcity was always time). Refrain: "Finders tell their friends."
